timeline.text: Locals pushed for a railroad depot in Castle Rock, the designated seat of the newly realigned Douglas County.
A depot of rhyolite stone went up on Third Street on the Denver & Rio Grande line.
The Castle Rock Chamber of Commerce created the Starlighting celebration.
The depot was moved to 420 Elbert Street.
The Castle Rock Historical Society opened the Castle Rock Museum in the depot in October.
